3 AAdvantage® miles for every $1 spent on eligible American Airlines purchases2

What benefits does the Citi® / AAdvantage® Globe™ Mastercard® offer?The Citi® / AAdvantage® Globe™ Mastercard® gives you access to a suite of premium travel benefits including:
4 Admirals Club® Globe™ Passes to American Airlines Admirals Club® Lounges every year2
First checked bag free on domestic American Airlines itineraries (for you and up to 8 companions on the same reservation)2
Preferred boarding on American Airlines flights (for you and up to 8 companions traveling with you and listed on the same reservation)2
An American Airlines Companion Certificate starting in your second cardmembership year as long as your cardmembership is renewed. Redeeming the certificate costs $99 for the ticketing fee, plus taxes and fees based on itinerary2
Global Entry® or TSA PreCheck® application fee credit of up to $120 every 4 years2
Travel Protection Benefits: MasterRental Coverage, Common Carrier Trip Cancellation and Trip Interruption, Trip Delay, Lost or Damaged Luggage, Extended Warranty and Purchase Assurance Plus2
In addition to these travel benefits, the Citi® / AAdvantage® Globe™ Mastercard® also offers:
Up to $240 in Statement Credits on TuroEarn up to $30 in statement credits for each eligible Turo trip completed, for a total of up to $240 in statement credits annually. To qualify, you must link your card to your Turo account on Turo.com/Globe and pay for the trip with your card.2
Up to $100 Annual Splurge Credit®Every calendar year, earn up to $100 in statement credits on your choice of up to 2 of the following brands: 1stDibs, eligible AAdvantage Hotels® bookings, Future Personal Training and Live Nation® (exclusions apply).2
Up to $100 Statement Credit on American Airlines Inflight PurchasesEvery calendar year, earn up to $100 in statement credits on inflight purchases when you use your card on American Airlines flights.2
Flight Streak™ BonusEarn a 5,000 Loyalty Point bonus after every 4 qualifying American Airlines flights (up to 15,000 additional Loyalty Points each status qualification year).2
How can I redeem my AAdvantage® miles earned with the Citi® / AAdvantage® Globe™ Mastercard®?
Citi® / AAdvantage® Globe™ Mastercard® cardmembers can redeem their AAdvantage® miles on aa.com for a variety of exciting travel rewards, such as:
Flights to nearly 1,000 destinations across the globe
Upgrades on most domestic and international flights marketed and operated by American Airlines
Hotels in over 500 destinations worldwide, car rentals and more!
How can I earn Loyalty Points with the Citi® / AAdvantage® Globe™ Mastercard®?You will earn 1 Loyalty point toward AAdvantage® status for every eligible AAdvantage® mile you earn with your Citi® / AAdvantage® Globe™ Mastercard®.
You can also earn up to 15,000 additional Loyalty Points with the Flight Streak™ Bonus: after every 4 qualifying American Airlines flights, the primary credit cardmember will earn 5,000 additional Loyalty Points, up to 15,000 additional Loyalty Points each status qualification year, defined as the AAdvantage® membership year from the first day of March through the last day of February.
Do you get a statement credit for TSA Precheck® or Global Entry® with the Citi® / AAdvantage® Globe™ Mastercard®?
You’re eligible to receive a statement credit (up to $120 every 4 years) as reimbursement for your application fee for Global Entry® or TSA PreCheck®.2
Does the Citi® / AAdvantage® Globe™ Mastercard® come with lounge access?The Citi® / AAdvantage® Globe™ Mastercard® comes with 4 Admirals Club® Globe™ Passes to American Airlines Admirals Club® Lounges every year.2
Does the Citi® / AAdvantage® Globe™ Mastercard® have a foreign transaction fee?
The Citi® / AAdvantage® Globe™ Mastercard® does not charge foreign transaction fees.1
Is the first checked bag free with the Citi® / AAdvantage® Globe™ Mastercard®?
As a Citi® / AAdvantage® Globe™ Mastercard® cardmember, your first checked bag is free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for you and up to 8 travel companions listed on the same reservation.
